description: Sidebar redesign (HTML + CSS + JS) and Chat page redesign (HTML + CSS + JS). These are coupled: the sidebar partial is embedded in the chat page and the chat.js loadSessions() populates the sidebar session list. Both must be done together to avoid a broken intermediate state. Independent of FEAT-001 only if FEAT-001's CSS variables are already in place.
steps: Rewrite templates/partials/sidebar.html to the Nebula structure. Keep all Jinja2 expressions unchanged (url_for, current_user). New structure: <aside id='sidebar' class='sidebar' role='navigation' aria-label='Main navigation'>. Inside: (1) .sidebar-brand: a.brand-link href=url_for('pages.dashboard') with a violet circle div.brand-icon containing letter 'C' + span.brand-name 'Crystal AI'. (2) button#new-chat-btn.new-chat-btn with plus SVG icon + 'New Chat' text (only shown on chat page — use class, not conditional). (3) .sidebar-search: label.sr-only + input#session-search type=search placeholder='Search chats…' with inline search SVG icon in a wrapper. (4) .sidebar-sessions#session-list role=list (populated by chat.js). (5) nav.sidebar-nav: 5 links using url_for — Dashboard (grid SVG), Chat (chat-bubble SVG), History (clock SVG), Documents (file SVG), Profile (user SVG). Admin link conditional as before. Each link: a.sidebar-link with span.nav-icon (inline SVG) + span.nav-label. (6) .sidebar-footer: div.user-avatar-wrap with div.user-avatar (initials from display_name[0] or 'U') + div.user-meta (span.user-name, span.user-email) + button#logout-btn.btn-logout with logout-arrow SVG. IMPORTANT: preserve id='session-list', id='new-chat-btn', id='logout-btn', id='session-search', id='sidebar', class='sidebar-link' — these IDs/classes are used by chat.js and sidebar.js.

Write inline SVG icon definitions to use in sidebar.html. SVG icons needed (all 24x24 viewBox, stroke-based, currentColor): (a) plus: two lines forming +. (b) search: circle + line (magnifier). (c) chat-bubble: speech bubble rounded rect. (d) grid/dashboard: 2x2 grid squares. (e) clock/history: circle with clock hands. (f) file/documents: page with folded corner. (g) user/profile: head+shoulders silhouette. (h) logout-arrow: door with arrow pointing out. Use stroke='currentColor' fill='none' strokeWidth='2' strokeLinecap='round' strokeLinejoin='round'. Embed directly inline in the HTML — no separate SVG sprite file.
